shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.store: The camera stands on the sidewalk across from the shop and looks straight at its whole front: the door and the big shop window are clearly visible. The shop has NO sign, no name and no writing anywhere; what it is must be obvious only from what fills the window.

assets.item: Ana arrives in the city (mission kickoff).
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep the face, hair, skin and build exactly; keep her sage-green overshirt over a white top and her jeans. Create a new photograph of Ana stepping off a silver train onto a busy city station platform with her dark-blue rolling suitcase and a smile, the station's tall glass roof and the city skyline beyond it.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: He's late. / She's early. / He takes the train. / She buys a ticket.
assets.prompt: A big bright train station hall seen from a high balcony, wide and evenly lit, with four people far apart from LEFT to RIGHT: (1) on the far left a man in a green jacket RUNS fast with a briefcase toward a train whose doors are closing; (2) left of center a woman in a yellow coat SITS alone on a long empty bench reading a book, early; (3) right of center a man in a grey coat steps INTO the open door of a waiting silver train with a suitcase; (4) on the far right a woman in a purple coat stands at a ticket window and takes a paper ticket from a clerk behind the glass. No other people are in the hall.

assets.item: the bakery / the bookstore / the police station / the gas station
assets.prompt: A wide, sunny view along one side of a town street, seen from across the road, with four separate buildings in a row from LEFT to RIGHT, each clearly different: (1) a bakery with a big window full of bread; (2) a bookstore with a big window full of colorful books; (3) a red-brick police station with a plain white police car with a light bar parked in front, the car showing no word; (4) a small gas station with a white roof over two pumps with blank displays. Each building fills about a quarter of the photo width.

assets.item: You can't swim / ride your bike / take photos here; you can sit here.
assets.prompt: A wide sunny view of a city park beside a lake, with four separate spots from LEFT to RIGHT: (1) at the lake shore a round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out swimmer; (2) on a paved path a round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out bicycle; (3) in front of a small white museum door a round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out camera; (4) an empty wooden park bench with no sign at all. Every sign is a white circle with a thick red border and a red diagonal bar, with a simple black pictogram and NO letters or numbers, big and easy to read. Each spot fills about a quarter of the photo width.

assets.item: She has a reservation. / Here's your key. / He takes the elevator. / This is her room.
assets.prompt: A wide, bright hotel lobby seen from a high balcony, with four separate groups from LEFT to RIGHT: (1) at the wooden front desk a woman in a red dress hands her passport to a receptionist; (2) further along the same desk a receptionist hands a brass key to a man in a brown jacket; (3) a man in a blue suit with a suitcase steps into an open elevator with steel doors; (4) on the right, through an open door, a woman with grey hair sits on the white bed of a hotel room. No signs, screens or numbers anywhere.
A friendly ticket clerk, a man of about fifty with glasses and a grey uniform shirt, sits behind the glass of a train-station ticket window and looks at the camera as if asking a question.

assets.item: Do you have a reservation? (voice gate)
assets.prompt: A friendly hotel receptionist, a young woman with a dark braid and a navy blazer, stands behind a wooden front desk and looks at the camera as if asking a question; a plant and soft light behind.
